ato_criteria.value: Minimum annual turnover of Rs. 11,79,98,000.00 for any one of the preceding 3 years (2025-2026, 2024-25 & 2023-24) for LBP Chennai/Manali.

similar_work_definition.value: Bidder should have supplied 0.9 mm &/or 1.0 mm &/or 1.25 mm or 18G to 22G of MS Plain Barrels/Drums, MS open top Grease Barrel/Drums, MS EPI-coated/Epoxy coated Barrels/Drums, MS Galvanized Barrels / Zinc electroplated barrels/Drums, or MS Composite Barrels/Drums to any industry.
similar_work_definition.source_quote: Bidder should have supplied 0.9 mm &/or 1.0 mm &/or 1.25 mm or 18G to 22G (“G”- Stands for Gauge), of following types of barrels to any industry: MS Plain Barrels/Drums, &/or MS open top Grease Barrel/Drums, &/or MS EPI-coated/Epoxy coated Barrels/Drums, &/or MS Galvanized Barrels / Zinc electroplated barrels/Drums, &/or MS Composite Barrels/Drums.
